title: Panthers "hopeful" Jaelan Phillips, Monroe Freeling can return after Week 5 bye

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Panthers "hopeful" Jaelan Phillips, Monroe Freeling can return after Week 5 bye
sources.description: The Panthers have a bye in Week 5 and that will give a couple of their injured players a little more time to heal before they are back on the field.
